item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar is full of reminders about perspective, and they all point to one skill: noticing the story you're telling before you act on it. A thought isn't a fact. Mind reading and projecting feel like insight, but they're guesses. Before you react today, pause and ask whether this moment supports the life you're building. Action: the next time you feel a strong reaction, name the assumption behind it.
